title: Use a fridge to cool items before disposal
description: Use this when a task requires placing a cooled item into a destination.
content: To cool an item, first locate and open a fridge, then take the target item and use the "cool [item] with [fridge]" action while at the fridge. After cooling, proceed to the destination and move the item there.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a cool apple in garbagecan.

title: Use a microwave to heat objects when a stoveburner is occupied or unresponsive
description: Use this when you need to heat an object and placing it on a stoveburner repeatedly fails or the burner already contains another item.
content: To heat an object, first open the microwave, move the object into it, then use the heat action with the microwave while holding the object. Do not waste time trying to move the object onto a stoveburner if the burner is occupied or the move action returns "Nothing happens."

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a hot apple in fridge.

title: Complete heating before placing an item in the fridge
description: Use this when a task requires an item to be both heated and refrigerated, and the order of operations matters.
content: Heat the item first, then transport it to the fridge and place it inside. If you place the item in the fridge before heating it, you must retrieve it, heat it, and return it to the fridge to satisfy the task.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a hot apple in fridge.

title: Open containers before moving items into them
description: Use this whenever you need to place an object into a closed appliance or container such as a fridge or microwave.
content: Always open the target container before attempting to move an item into it. After moving the item, close the container if needed, and verify success by opening it again or checking the inventory.
